name: Canton Swap Broker
description: Pay-per-call x402 wrapper around the OneSwap escrow-swap SDK on Canton Network. Live market catalogs, CC/token swap quotes, escrowed cross-user swap creation and lifecycle tracking ($0.02-\$0.05 per call, USDC on Base). No API keys - agents pay per call via x402 v2. Three settled mainnet swaps as proof, live 24/7.
